title: Powerball's Jackpot Denominator Grew 67%
hook: Powerball's jackpot denominator grew 67%, making every ticket weaker.
closing: Bigger jackpots came from making an already remote win even harder.
question: Would that stop you playing?

segments.say: Powerball's jackpot denominator is 292,201,338, making a lifetime lightning strike dramatically more likely.
A royal flush has a 649,740 denominator, still far easier than the Powerball jackpot.
The old Powerball denominator was 175 million; the later rule made the jackpot substantially harder.
